name: Ethical Considerations in Telecommunication Technologies and Management
description: Professional ethical guidelines, as adopted in most electronics and telecommunications engineering societies in the world, ethics in publishing, anti-plagiarism, ethical use of technical tools (AI, ChatGPT, internet, etc.), examples of unethical behaviour in the engineering profession, case studies on engineering ethics.
